items.text: My prayers are with Majority Leader @SteveScalise and his loved ones while he undergoes treatment. Wishing you a smooth and efficient recovery.

For 59 years, the #FoodStampAct has been helping Americans put food on the table.

@SenTinaSmith and I introduced the Enabling Farmers to Benefit from Processing Nutrition Programs Act because Everyone deserves access to healthy food & farmers should benefit from these programs.

The @NIH relies on federal dollars to fund research efforts on diseases like cancer and Alzheimer's.

If the gov't shuts down, clinical trials will be halted and patients won't be able to access potentially lifesaving treatment.

It's time to pass the budget and fix this mess. https://t.co/gxlWUQzLL2

Exercise is critical to both physical and mental wellness, but far too often, working families are priced out of sports and fitness programs.

I co-sponsored the PHIT Act to make these programs more accessible so West Michiganders can lead healthier and happier lives. https://t.co/KifGfsLFhO

It’s amazing to see continued investments in addiction recovery services for West Michiganders!

Exercise has so many mental and physical health benefits, and I’m so grateful that this resource is available to support our neighbors.
https://t.co/nXoodJCYBU

I’m grateful we’re continuing to fund WIC.

But let’s be clear: it was NOT easy to get House Republicans to fund ESSENTIAL nutrition assistance for women, infants, and children in need.

We shouldn't be fighting for the bare minimum. Working families deserve better.
Today, I toured @UofMHealthWest where I got to see that innovation at work in early detection for breast cancer—giving patients and their doctors the best tools to fight! https://t.co/iTEmAjpxHL

Abortion bans restrict doctors’ ability to help pregnant patients. 

Abortions are medical procedures. When you create laws that ignore the medical community’s advice, you put women at risk.
https://t.co/YTg5MOim5n

Reproductive healthcare decisions are very personal and often difficult.

I introduced an important bill alongside @RepTedLieu, @RepSaraJacobs, @RepDeborahRoss, & @RepMaxwellFrost to ensure that patients and providers are guaranteed digital privacy as they seek and provide care.

Radiology makes it easier for doctors to diagnose and treat patients.

This technology is always evolving, and I’m glad I could talk to doctors and researchers from @michiganradiol1 about how I can support their cutting-edge work in West Michigan and across the state.

This week marked Prader-Willi Syndrome Awareness Day. PWS is a rare genetic disease that impacts roughly 1 in 15,000.

It was inspiring to hear from my neighbors living with PWS and discuss the need for more research and greater access to treatment. https://t.co/4HeEprp1jH

This year, I secured $5M for Friends of GR Parks to help them increase equity in urban tree canopy coverage & enhance the city’s green spaces.

This has incredible mental and physical health benefits for our neighbors. I'm so glad we could make it happen!
https://t.co/wvg2Gxv1s3
Corewell Health has been impacted by today’s Microsoft outages, but emergency rooms and hospitals are still open. https://t.co/MhE8GfKXfq
When you exercise your right to vote today, I invite you to reflect on the brave advocates who fought tirelessly — and continue fighting — to expand and protect our place at the polls.

Tomorrow, Muskegon Family Care is commemorating National Health Care Center Week with a free community wellness fair. From 12 pm - 4 pm, residents can access free blood pressure screenings, diabetes checks, and various preventative care exams. Read more: https://t.co/CybOLkleVI
Just 65 days until we exercise our right to vote on Election Day. Make sure you know your polling place and make a voting plan today.  https://t.co/Fa6XgCj2PY

We’re focused on election integrity this week. Big thanks to our incredible Secretary of State @JocelynBenson for helping ALL eligible Michiganders exercise their constitutional right! https://t.co/O8kzAfcc3J

Dr. Cara Poland is a trailblazer, helping guide our physicians on best practices when caring for patients who suffer from substance use disorders. It was powerful to speak with her this #NationalRecoveryMonth. https://t.co/fCCK3ozSTd

This #WorldHeartDay, let's love our hearts.❤️

Cardiovascular disease is the #1 leading cause of death worldwide, but we can decrease our vulnerabilities to it through a healthy lifestyle and diet. Keep moving and get your blood pumping today, West Michigan!

What an honor to have @PineRestGR in my district—one of the largest mental health care providers in MI, supporting community members of all ages with treatment & recovery. Loved seeing progress of the new pediatric center & learning about their work to support our youngest minds. https://t.co/4OHHdnBVTB

West Michigan, our Secretary of State @JocelynBenson is doing everything in her power to keep your vote safe and expand options to exercise your vote.

We teamed up to remind you of all the upcoming deadlines. Visit https://t.co/VyRRtj43Cu for more resources! https://t.co/XLw0KEJpPj

Health care and traditional medicine can work in tandem, and the Nottawaseppi Huron Band Tribal Council proves that with its community-centric healing model. I was honored to tour their facilities and learn about the behavioral, dental, and primary care they offer to patients. https://t.co/P7D2BVNd0E

The time to enroll in or change plans for health care coverage starting January 1 is NOW through December 15.

And remember, for beneficiaries of Medicare Part D, the yearly cap on prescription costs will be $2,000 starting in 2025. Learn more at https://t.co/sWcjzEwpkQ. ❤️‍🩹

His tragic passing in a helicopter training exercise last February devastated the West Michigan community. Renaming the post office in his honor now solidifies his legacy for generations to come, and it has been an honor to work with his family to pass this bill.

Today I had a chance to observe a training exercise of @uscg’s ice rescue operations — one of the services our Coasties lead to save lives every winter. I’m determined to ensure they have the resources necessary to continue carrying out these crucial missions. https://t.co/JEVCzG5zTh
